associations.rationale: The formal type only presents Vrep a as a Type and does not expose either one-dimensionality or the coordinate action.
The displayed equality states that every polynomial q acts on Vrep a through evaluation at a, but it does not state that Vrep a is one-dimensional.
The formal type only presents polyAlg as a type-valued function on Nat and does not identify it with the polynomial algebra or state the Vrep action.
